fields.name: titleFont
fields.tooltip: Big headings. 03.UI/Font/Kenney Future.ttf.

fields.name: bodyFont
fields.tooltip: Menu rows and body copy. 03.UI/Font/Kenney Future Narrow.ttf.

fields.name: rowPlate
fields.tooltip: Background plate behind a menu row. Suggested: button_square_header_notch_rectangle.

fields.name: titlePlate
fields.tooltip: Title bar of a sub-screen. Suggested: button_square_header_blade_rectangle_screws.

fields.name: sliderTrack
fields.tooltip: Empty slider track. Suggested: bar_round_large.

fields.name: sliderFill
fields.tooltip: Filled portion of a slider. Suggested: bar_round_gloss_large.

fields.name: toggleBox
fields.tooltip: Box of the subtitles toggle — the kit has no checkbox sprite, so a small bar end stands in. Suggested: bar_square_small_square.

fields.name: selectionMarker
fields.tooltip: Marker beside the focused row, and the tick inside the toggle. Suggested: crosshair_color_a.

fields.name: glyphStart
fields.tooltip: Shown under PRESS START on the attract screen while a controller is connected.

fields.name: glyphBumperLeft
fields.tooltip: Left bumper, for the dash hint while a controller is connected.

fields.name: glyphBumperRight
fields.tooltip: Right bumper, for the dash hint while a controller is connected.

fields.name: backdrop
fields.tooltip: Full-screen backdrop. Keep it near-opaque: the run is frozen behind the menu, not hidden.

fields.name: plateIdle
fields.tooltip: Tint of an unfocused row plate.

fields.name: plateFocused
fields.tooltip: Tint of the focused row plate.

fields.name: mainColumnX
fields.tooltip: X of the main menu's column at 1920x1080, measured from screen centre.

fields.name: entranceDuration
fields.tooltip: How long one item takes to arrive. The whole entrance is this plus the stagger of the last item.

fields.name: entranceSlide
fields.tooltip: How far left of its resting place an item starts.

fields.name: entranceStagger
fields.tooltip: Delay added per item, so rows arrive one after another instead of as a block.

fields.name: titleLead
fields.tooltip: Head start the screen title gets over the rows.

fields.name: entranceCurve
fields.tooltip: Shape of every eased move. Ease out: quick departure, soft landing.

fields.name: focusEaseSeconds
fields.tooltip: Smoothing time of the highlight and of a row's scale/alpha. The highlight never teleports.

fields.name: screenTransition
fields.tooltip: Main to sub-screen and back. Input is locked for exactly this long.

fields.name: loadingFillSeconds
fields.tooltip: Time the bar takes to fill from empty to full at its steady pace — also the least time the curtain stays up. The bar is time-driven: a scene loads in one hitch, so a progress readout would sit at 0 and slam to 1; the bar climbs to half, the hitch happens there, and the second half fills once the scene is in.

fields.name: loadingSpinner
fields.tooltip: Bottom-right corner sprite — the PS1 spinning disc. Empty for now: the slot is hidden until a sprite is assigned.

fields.name: loadingSpinnerSpin
fields.tooltip: Spin rate of the corner sprite, clockwise. 0 keeps it still.

fields.name: attractPulseAlpha
fields.tooltip: Alpha the PRESS prompt pulses between.

fields.name: stickDeadZone
fields.tooltip: Left stick deflection that counts as a direction.

fields.name: repeatDelay
fields.tooltip: How long a direction must be held before it starts repeating.

fields.name: repeatInterval
fields.tooltip: Repeat rate once it starts.

fields.name: inputGrace
fields.tooltip: Deaf period after any screen opens, so the press that opened it cannot also confirm inside it.

fields.name: mixer
fields.tooltip: The game mixer (Master → Gameplay → Music/FX/Voice, plus UI, PauseMusic and LoadingMusic). Must expose MasterVolume, MusicVolume, SFXVolume, UIVolume and VoiceVolume, and carry the Gameplay/Paused/Loading snapshots — see GameAudio.

fields.name: uiOutput
fields.tooltip: Group the menu's own blips route through — the mixer's UI bus, which sits under Master (not Gameplay) so it is never ducked by the pause snapshot.

fields.name: moveClip
fields.tooltip: Focus moved to another row, or a debug tab flipped. 07.Audio/02.UI rollover*.

fields.name: confirmClip
fields.tooltip: Row activated, sub-screen opened, run started. 07.Audio/02.UI click*.

fields.name: backClip
fields.tooltip: Backed out of a screen / returned to attract. 07.Audio/02.UI click*.

fields.name: adjustClip
fields.tooltip: A slider or toggle stepped left/right. Falls back to the move clip when empty. 07.Audio/02.UI switch*.

fields.name: debriefClip
fields.tooltip: The debrief (Mission Complete) panel powering on. 07.Audio/01.SFX/FiniteRunner computerNoise*. Empty = silent.

fields.name: pauseMusicClip
fields.tooltip: Loops on the mixer's PauseMusic bus while the pause menu is up. Left empty on purpose: no placeholder audio ships with the menu.

fields.name: pauseAudioFade
fields.tooltip: Seconds the pause crossfade takes — gameplay buses fade out, pause music fades in. The mixer updates on unscaled time, so it plays out at timeScale 0.

fields.name: loadingMusicClip
fields.tooltip: Loops on the mixer's LoadingMusic bus while the loading curtain is up. 07.Audio/03.Music/LoadingScreen.

fields.name: loadingAudioFade
fields.tooltip: Seconds the loading crossfade takes — every gameplay bus (and any pause music) fades out and the loading music in as the curtain rises, and back as it lifts. Unscaled time.

fields.name: cinemaAudioFade
fields.tooltip: Seconds a world-freezing cinema takes to fade the in-game buses out as it opens, and back in once it is done or skipped. The clip's own sound rides the Cinema bus, untouched. Unscaled time.

fields.name: moveRumbleSeconds
fields.tooltip: How long the cursor-move tick lasts (its strength is moveRumble, on the light motor only).

fields.name: rankSlamRumble
fields.tooltip: The mission-complete rank letter slamming down. (low motor, high motor, seconds)
